verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly shows that events carry user context. The Correlated Events feature groups events sharing the same user, device, session, or trace, and handled exceptions can be reported via Bugsnag.notify(). Nothing in the pack documents breadcrumbs or custom tags/metadata. Missing for 10: any evidence of breadcrumb capture, a custom tags/metadata API, explicit SDK docs for setting user context per event, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
